report.summary: Patient P-D008 (41M, Medicaid with transport benefit) screened positive for two needs: utilities shutoff risk and transportation need. Housing and food are secure. Utilities options: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in Tuesdays for disconnection notices), Lakeside Energy Assistance (open to everyone; mark likely_ok; ref ATKA2858F), and Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based, apply in person Mon/Wed). Transport options: Medicaid Ride Line is the best fit given Medicaid coverage with a transport benefit (call number on card ≥2 business days ahead); Senior Shuttle West is not eligible (age 60+, patient is 41); Paratransit requires ADA certification (up to 21 days) and is less clearly applicable. A transit-trip check for the upcoming clinic appointment could not be run because no facility location is on file.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic
options.how_to_access: Walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays.

options.name: Lakeside Energy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Eligibility: everyone. Mark likely_ok per resource guidance; reference code ATKA2858F.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help
options.how_to_access: Income-based help with gas and electric bills; apply in person Mon/Wed.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Medicaid plan member benefit; call the number on the insurance card at least 2 business days before the appointment.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Eligibility not clearly established for this patient.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments weekdays 7 AM-5 PM; patient is 41, so not eligible.
